Thanks Marissa — great summary. A few clarifications from procurement/finance on our side: 

- PO: We require a signed PO to process vendor invoices. For SaaS vendors we typically do a monthly consolidated PO tied to a single contract number. That works best for AP.
- Net terms: Net30 is preferred. Occasionally Net45 for new vendors, but procurement prefers Net30 on new vendor relationships.
- Invoice data: Invoice must include PO number, our cost center field (CC1234), vendor legal name, vendor tax ID, and the billing address below.
- Tax/VAT: We are US-headquartered; no VAT. Please confirm you will include our state tax exemption certificate if applicable (we will provide).
- Attachments: I'm attaching our PO template and supplier onboarding form — procurement will need the onboarding form completed for vendor setup.

Billing address (for invoice header):
Finex Corp
Accounts Payable
Attn: AP Processing
1980 Market St, Suite 600
San Francisco, CA 94103

Please fill out the supplier onboarding form and return. Also include Redwood's vendor tax ID on the form so procurement can validate.
